name: Shaw AFB
description: Home of the 20th Fighter Wing and Ninth Air Force. Shaw AFB projects F-16CM combat air power and supports major combatant commands.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate. VCC adjacent to Main Gate on Broad St/Shaw Dr.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: After-hours passes at Main Gate Security Forces. Phone: 803-895-2038.
gates.address: Broad St/Shaw Dr, Shaw AFB, SC 29152

resources.name: CMSgt Emerson E. Williams Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting the 20th Fighter Wing and tenant units.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Bfast 0600-0800, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1630-1900, Midnight 2300-0030; Sat-Sun: Bfast 0730-1230, Dinner 1630-1800, Midnight 2300-0030

resources.name: Shaw Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Shaw Main Exchange with food court (Subway, Anthony's Pizza), barber, beauty shop, optical, and retail.

resources.name: SAFE Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: Shaw Fitness & Health Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports amenities.
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri 0500-2100, Sat-Sun 0800-1800; 24/7 CAC access after registration

resources.name: Shaw Fitness & Health Center Annex
resources.description: Second fitness location supporting the Shaw community.
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri 0700-1400 (seasonal); 24/7 CAC access after registration

resources.name: Carolina Pines Inn (Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging including DVQ and family quarters. 24-hour front desk and continental breakfast.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, EFMP, school liaison, and family programs.

resources.name: 20th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, Wateree Recreation Area, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Carolina Lakes Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with Tee Top Café.
resources.hours: See pro shop for hours and tee times

resources.name: 20th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center
primaryAction.address: Outside Main Gate, Shaw AFB, SC 29152

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Carolina Pines Inn (803-895-3803) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 20 FSS, M&FRC, and official Shaw sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
